stem: A prospective review identifies a clinically significant interaction before dispensing. Select all supported actions.

choices.text: Use professional judgment to evaluate and resolve the issue before dispensing.
Ignore the alert because the prescription is electronically signed.
Communicate with the prescriber or patient when needed to resolve the concern.
Delegate final resolution to a cashier.
Dispense first and perform prospective review next month.
